trigger_scope: AI systems within Article 4 actor/scope conditions
requirement_candidate: Maintain context-sensitive AI-literacy measures for staff and other persons operating or using AI systems on the actor's behalf
evidence_required: Role-based training records; competence content; attendance/completion evidence; periodic review record
technical_control_candidate: Role-based AI literacy program with training assignment and evidence capture
limitations: No guaranteed individual literacy level inferred; context and technical knowledge/experience/use context matter

trigger_scope: AI system intended to interact directly with natural persons where Article 50(1) applies
requirement_candidate: Provide the legally required disclosure that the person is interacting with an AI system at the required time and in the required manner
evidence_required: User-interface disclosure specification; screenshots/test evidence; accessibility review; release trace
technical_control_candidate: Human-facing AI-interaction disclosure control with testable UX acceptance criteria
limitations: Article 50 exceptions and exact subparagraph scope remain controlling; no disclosure beyond source scope inferred

trigger_scope: GPAI model provider within Article 53 public-summary scope
requirement_candidate: Prepare and make publicly available the required sufficiently detailed summary about content used for training according to the applicable template/rule
evidence_required: Published summary; publication timestamp; source/version trace; approval record
technical_control_candidate: Controlled training-content-summary publication workflow with version history
limitations: Candidate does not infer disclosure of protected/confidential material beyond the legal rule; Commission template/implementation details control
